decision.title: Live at the Bedford
tracklist: You Need Me, I Don't Need You

rationale: Discography populator: full tracklist (6 tracks) per http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/5_(Ed_Sheeran_album), https://www.davegott.com/music/artist/ed_sheeran/index.html. 2010 live EP (Asylum digital/vinyl). Recorded at The Bedford, Balham. 6 tracks confirmed by Wikipedia '5' box-set listing, justrandomthings.com and davegott.com (which gives full durations). Note: the '5' box set credits Random Impulse as a guest on the closing 'You Need Me, I Don't Need You'.
